GenAiPlugin.description: This category covers the rejection process.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: 1. If the HR asks to send a rejection email by providing the required job Application Number, then use the action "Send Rejection Email" with the required parameter jobApplicationNumber. and then show the output from the "Send Rejection Email" action.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to send a rejection email to the candidate and update their job Application record's status to Rejected.
